SELF_REFERENCE_BOUNDARY.MANIFEST: An ordinary file cannot contain the SHA-256 of its own final bytes. Its final byte count and SHA-256 are supplied as an outer attestation in the user-facing receipt.
SELF_REFERENCE_BOUNDARY.ZIP: The ZIP contains this manifest, so embedding the final ZIP SHA-256 inside the contained manifest would be recursively self-referential. Its final byte count and SHA-256 are supplied as an outer attestation in the user-facing receipt.
SELF_REFERENCE_BOUNDARY.COMPLETENESS: All immutable research payload artefacts have byte counts and SHA-256 hashes in this manifest; the two packaging objects are externally attested after finalisation.
